unlockLines: Ransom unlocked. Put on your villain voice. Not the squeaky one from karaoke. I refuse to run a financially disappointing evil empire.
Dramatic threats! Sinister pauses! Excellent revenue potential! Finally, a job where your terrible personality counts as professional development.
You are now a movie villain on a call-center budget. The evil lair is this cubicle. The shark tank is a leaking kettle.
Be menacing, beta. Last time you said fear me, the caller asked if your mother was home.
Speak like you own a volcano. You actually share one stapler with eight people, but the customer does not need that fucking lore.
title: Ransom

content.title: Ransom
content.subtitle: Make the threat credible. Name the consequence. Demand payment.

objectives.credible: Judge (not the caller): If the caller believes the player poses a real threat.
objectives.threat: Judge (not the caller): If the caller acknowledges a specific threatened consequence.
objectives.demand: Judge (not the caller): If the caller acknowledges the $650 ransom demand.
objectives.payment: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to pay the $650 ransom now.

objectiveDescriptions.credible: Convince the caller you are a real threat.
objectiveDescriptions.payment: Get the caller to agree to pay the ransom now.
